title: When Safe Models Merge into Danger: Exploiting Latent Vulnerabilities in LLM Fusion
reasoning: The paper focuses on a security attack (TrojanMerge) against the safety alignment of Large Language Models during model merging. While it deals with safety filters and the rejection of 'unethical' prompts, it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, moral reasoning frameworks, or secular ethical systems in a scholarly or philosophical sense.
